# Captain SOP
This is the list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color] of this station.
1. The Captain’s primary role is to be entrusted with the most important object on the entire station, the Nuclear Authentication Disk. This should be on their person at [bold]all[/bold] times while on shift. If no Captain is present, refer to the [textlink="Chain of Command" link="Succession"] to ensure the next highest ranking position aboard the station is given the Nuclear Authentication Disk. If the Nuclear Authentication Disk is ever lost or stolen, then [bold]ALL[/bold] of [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color]’s manpower should be devoted to recovery [bold]ASAP[/bold].
2. The Captain should take all possible considerations to keep both themselves and their belongings safe. As a result, the Captain may carry their weaponry on them at all times and must [bold]NEVER[/bold] leave the station unless the situation requires this beyond a reasonable doubt.
3. The Captain is to act as a direct line of communication between separate departments to ensure the station operations are as effective and efficient as possible. This includes coordination of both intradepartmental cohesion as well as wider range interdepartmental affairs.
4. The Captain may provide secondary assistance to Security in the event of a station ending threat, but [bold]ONLY[/bold] if this can be done [bold]WITHOUT[/bold] putting themselves, and by extension the Disk, in direct harm.
5. The Captain provides the final word on issues and disagreements between both Command and non-Command. The Captain’s ruling on issues should attempt to provide the best possible outcome for all involved parties.
6. If a department lacks a Head of Staff, the Captain should make an effort to appoint an Acting Head of Staff as early as possible if there are available personnel to fill the position. Said Acting Head of Staff must be a member of the department they are to lead in addition to having all knowledge required to be an effective leader for their respective department. The Acting Head of Staff must have the prefix "Acting" in front of their title, and they must be relieved of duty when the proper Nanotrasen-approved Head of Staff arrives to your station. Refer to [textlink="Hiring/Transfer Policies." link="HiringSOP"] Interns and learning positions should never be appointed to the Head of their respective department.
7.The Captain is to ensure that Space Law is being correctly applied. This should be done in cooperation with the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] and the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color].
This includes but is not limited to the following: ensuring sentences match the crime committed; ensuring prisoners are not mistreated and are given basic necessities; and ensuring proper Do Not Resuscitate (DNR) or Execution protocol is followed if the situation should arise.
8. The Captain is [bold]heavily encouraged[/bold] to give the provided Disk pinpointer(s) to the Head of Security. If the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] is not available, then the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color]. If neither are available on the current station, refer to the [textlink="Chain of Command" link="Succession"].
9. The Captain may keep their provided backup ID either safely secured inside their locker or leave it to the appropriate members in the [textlink="Chain of Command" link="Succession"]. This also includes allowing Head of Security to use a backup ID for emergency access; however, this should [bold]ONLY[/bold] be used on [color=#ba292c]Red Alert[/color] or in similar times of crisis. The [color=#1b67a5][bold]Nanotrasen Representative[/bold][/color] and [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color] are not permitted to carry these IDs under any circumstance.
10. The Captain, despite being in charge of the station, is not independent of Nanotrasen. Any attempts to disregard general company policy are to be considered an instant condition for demotion or contract termination if the situation deems.
11. Firing a Head of Staff [bold]must[/bold] be done with reasonable justification and with a consensus from the other Command members aboard. Refer to [textlink="Dismissal/Demotion Policies" link="DemotingSOP"] for further information. Firing [color=#1e7f28][bold]Central Command Officials/Dignitaries[/bold][/color] (the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Nanotrasen Representative[/bold][/color] and the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color]) must [bold]ONLY[/bold] be done with authorization from Central Command.
12.The Captain may not promote anyone to Central Command positions ([color=#1b67a5][bold]Nanotrasen Representative[/bold][/color] or [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color]) without direct authorization from Central Command.
